test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are five boxes K, L, M, N and O, arranged one above the other. Box M is placed above box N. Box O is placed below box K. Box N is placed above K. Box L is placed below O. Which among the following is the bottom most box?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• Box M is placed above box N.
 
• Box O is placed below box K.
 
• Box L is placed below O.
 
• Box N is placed above K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2cf67e6a50166b6b570425dc58cf4e8a96814c8ba3fd5af529fa769cf6c72c8.png] 

 
• After combining the statements:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139a93faff1cb3e274dcd5287bebbbbfc5e589554ac897d990e618a6e69dd0c5.png] 

 
• Thus, L is the bottom-most box.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
